title: Message/set create: insert and enqueue are not atomic
description: process_create inserts the message row first, then enqueues to outbox as a separate non-transactional step. If enqueue fails (e.g. missing mailbox host), the message is left as Pending in the DB with no outbox entry — it will never be delivered. The caller gets notCreated/serverFail so they know, but the DB is in a partially-written state. Trigger: any enqueue failure path. Fix: wrap insert_message_with_attachments + outbox.enqueue inside a single SQLite transaction, rolling back the message insert if enqueue fails.
